_comment: Model catalog used by crewctl to validate the `model` field. credits is a multiplier relative to Auto = 1.0 (Kiro docs). free_tier: true = usable on the Free plan, false = paid plans only, null = not documented. id_status says how the id spelling was confirmed: seen-in-crew-cache (in ~/.kiro/crew/provider_models.json), seen-in-crew-source (in the installed Crew code), by-pattern (guessed from the naming pattern; verify in the dashboard model picker). Checked 2026-10-16.
